title: Projector Quantum Variational Ansatz
summary: Quantum computing offers several algorithms for computing the ground state of a problem Hamiltonian. Algorithms in the Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing (FTQC) regime, such as Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) and Quantum Signal Processing (QSP), are the most desirable because they offer optimal asymptotic scaling. In the Noisy Intermediate Scale Quantum (NISQ) regime, the most realistic approaches involve Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithms and their variants. A central difference between the two regimes is that FTQC algorithms do not prepare the ground state via direct state…
